name: Stoner Jr.
qaNote: Reference inspected. Preserve young adult face, short curls, olive hoodie, rainbow tie-dye, beige cargos, green sneakers, headphones and pendant. Cyan regions of tie-dye need keying review. Replace background green haze with bounded warm ivory/olive vapor, no scene wash. Review ice shatter, padlock release and headphone continuity.

result.prompt:
Create an EPIC 5-second illustrated fighting-game super finisher, portrait 9:16. Bold hand-inked outlines, rich cel shading, dynamic comic-book perspective, exaggerated scale and explosive acceleration. Reference image defines the exact character identity, face, costume, colors and props, NOT the background or initial camera crop. Preserve the illustrated character; no live-action or 3D makeover. Make a complete miniature action scene with a surprising payoff and a charismatic ending, not an idle animation with particles.
CAMERA AND COMPOSITING: cinematic camera motion is encouraged: dramatic pullbacks to reveal impossible scale, depth travel and deliberate close-ups. Establish the complete character early and return to a clear hero composition. Keep face and anatomy correct; intentional close-up crops are fine, accidental chopped limbs in a wide shot are not. The unoccupied backing remains perfectly flat pure cyan #00FFFF in EVERY shot, including close-ups. No scenery, floor plane, opaque rectangular manga panel, background gradient, vignette or full-frame whiteout. Use foreground objects and perspective to communicate distance. Large impact stars and disconnected tapered speed strokes terminate naturally on cyan instead of connecting to image borders. Warm effect colors with ink edges; no cyan/turquoise glow that will disappear under chroma key. No crowns. Use character-specific effects and props; do not add a recurring golden-fist emblem or generic fist-shaped power effect.
TEXT: one exact move title, thick uppercase comic lettering, warm white-to-gold fill, chunky black outline and dark offset extrusion, angled forceful slam with brief overshoot and settle. Stable readable spelling, intelligently placed away from the face, no additional captions or words. A title arrival is an impact beat of its own.
SOUND: strong synchronized anticipation, accelerating whooshes, exaggerated action hits, one dominant payoff, and a short settling tail. No music, speech or narration.

Stoner Jr. — Chill Out.
IDENTITY: exact young ADULT brown-skinned man with loose short dark curls, small chin beard, hoop earring, oversized olive-green hoodie, rainbow tie-dye shirt, very baggy beige cargo trousers, green canvas sneakers, pendant and black headphones around his neck. Preserve the clothes and colors. His magic uses thick warm-ivory vapor ribbons shaded olive with black ink edges, never cyan/turquoise or full-background haze.
0–0.7s: complete loose-limbed slouch. He lazily clicks one headphone earcup. Ahead floats a huge black speaker cabinet, taller than him, trapped in a jagged pale-lavender ice shell with a massive padlock across its speaker cone. He rolls his neck once as one small vapor ring drifts from his sleeve.
0.7–2.5s: camera whips around that ring as it balloons into a colossal rotating smoke wheel with an OPEN cyan center. He kicks back and rides its lower inner curve like an impossibly laid-back skateboard ramp. The wheel barrels around the frozen speaker, wraps it in one continuous loop and tightens with a gigantic ivory/olive pressure pulse. Ice explodes outward in finite lavender shards and the padlock springs wide, flying away. The now-free speaker flexes once with a single enormous bass THUMP that blasts the broken ice into the distant cyan. Full physical payoff, no music playing.
2.5–3.5s: camera snap-zooms back as the same vapor wheel folds into a compact floating hammock under him. Exact title CHILL OUT slams below his relaxed face with that deep bass impact. Hoodie strings and curls bounce once, body remains anatomically clean.
3.5–5s: whole character reclining on the small vapor hammock, shoes and face fully in frame, restored speaker drifting beside him. One tiny ice chip approaches his sneaker; without looking he toe-flicks it far away, then closes one eye. Keep the hammock bounded, cyan visible above and below; no floor or scenery. SFX: headphone click, gathering air swirl, huge rushing wheel, ice CRACK and lock SNAP, one dominant low bass hit, title slam and tiny ice tick. No speech, music or smoking apparatus.
